entries.mitigation: Tank faces Mathgamain away from the group; non-tanks stay out of the frontal cone.
Taunt the large adds and prioritize Stranglers before their poison pressure compounds.
Purge or avoid the targeted ice attack so the root does not trap a player during forest phases.
Kill resurrected stone adds quickly so repeated ground AoEs do not stack through the room.
The tank plugs active fire holes immediately to prevent escalating group damage.
Each player uses a separate outer platform when Galchobhar throws his weapon into the center.
Take the targeted lava ball toward an outer platform and avoid lingering until the platform collapses.

entries.entry_name: Chain Root — Gherig Bullblood and His Attendants
entries.mitigation: Interrupt the attendant channel immediately to free the two rooted players.
Aim targeted lava toward the wall and shift position slightly so the arena center stays usable.
Use the Stonefire Crucible to interrupt Stonefall outside Hard Mode; in Hard Mode survive it without brazier help.
Tank the copies and burn the newest lower-health copy quickly to reduce pressure.
Stack inside Morrigh's protective shield during the trebuchet barrage.
Every player blocks the stomp immediately; missing the block is lethal.
Tank blocks the charge toward the gate, or the group clears the charge line if it turns.
Spread personal circles and block when the comets land so players do not overlap damage.
Collect each green soul and deposit it into a separate light to progress the phase.
Kill adds near the boss and use the urn synergy to cleanse their corpses quickly.
Spread and finish corpse cleanses before the detonation channel resolves.
Tank faces the boss away from the group; non-tanks stay out of the frontal breath.
All four players hide behind the same assigned pillar for each shout so only one pillar is consumed.

entries.entry_name: Suck In and Melt — Domihaus the Bloody-Horned
entries.mitigation: Spread to four corners, then backpedal together to place personal AoEs without overlapping.
